## OtpError class

Base OTP Error Class

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class OtpError extends CustomError<OtpErrorCodesType> 
```
**Extends:** CustomError&lt;[OtpErrorCodesType](./auth-errors.otperrorcodestype.md)<!-- -->&gt;

## Remarks

Extends the framework's CustomError class to provide typed OTP errors. This serves as the foundation for all OTP-related errors in the system.

## Example


```typescript
throw new OtpError({
  code: 'OTP_INVALID',
  name: 'OtpError',
  logLevel: 'warn',
  message: 'The provided OTP code is invalid'
});
```
